question: How fully are the countless raptures of this realization presented here?
premises: Great raptures flow forth from this realization in countless numbers.
Their manifestations were already explained at length previously.
In this treatment by Abhinavagupta, only some of them are determined and set forth.
inference: Although the raptures of this realization are innumerable and previously detailed, only a few are definitively presented here.
uncertainties: The compound 'atrābhinavagupte' may refer to Abhinavagupta's present exposition or to a context within his teaching; taken as a locative reference to his treatment here.
plain_english: Great raptures flow forth, of which there is no number; their manifestations were already set out at length before, but here in Abhinavagupta's treatment only some are definitively stated.
